parts.text: Many household smoke alarms contain a sample of the radioactive isotope americium-241 (Am).

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Americium-241 is the isotope of the element americium that has the nucleon number (mass number) 241.

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) The isotope of neptunium produced by americium-241 is also radioactive. The decay of this isotope of neptunium produces an isotope of protactinium which decays by β -emission. β -particles are more penetrating than α -particles. The half-life of neptunium is longer than two million years. Using this information, explain the advantage of this long half-life for the use and safe disposal of a household smoke alarm. ........................................................................................................................................... ........................................................................................................................................... .....................................................................................................................................
